fields.summary_ko.0: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) with diversified businesses in insurance, railroads, and energy and disciplined capital allocation achieved 1-year outperformance of 12.5% vs. 13.6% for the insurance and property-casualty insurance industry.
